sspaste.catbox_note: No Imgur credentials, Gyazo token, or ImgBB API key are configured, so the image was uploaded to catbox.moe. Configure a host in config/sspaste.json to change this.
sspaste.config.title: SS Paste
sspaste.config.copy_screenshots.tooltip: Copy every F2 screenshot (including F1/HUD-hidden ones) to the system clipboard.
sspaste.config.show_feedback.tooltip: Show upload progress and errors in chat.
sspaste.config.max_size.tooltip: Images larger than this are downscaled before upload.
sspaste.config.uploader.tooltip: Auto: Imgur Client-ID if set, then Gyazo, then ImgBB, otherwise catbox.moe.
sspaste.config.gyazo_token.tooltip: Create an application on the Gyazo developer dashboard and generate an access token.
sspaste.config.gyazo_token.note: Uploads are saved to your Gyazo account.
sspaste.config.imgbb_key.tooltip: Free API key from api.imgbb.com. Uploads are permanent.
sspaste.config.gzo.note: gzo.ai (anonymous, expires after 24 hours; select it explicitly): %s
sspaste.config.show_chat_images.tooltip: Hover an image URL (Imgur, Gyazo, ImgBB, gzo.ai, Catbox) to preview it.
sspaste.config.preview_width.tooltip: Maximum display width of the in-chat image preview (GUI pixels).
sspaste.config.preview_height.tooltip: Maximum display height of the in-chat image preview (GUI pixels).
sspaste.config.texture_width.tooltip: Maximum resolution of the downloaded preview texture. The image is displayed smaller with linear filtering.
sspaste.config.texture_height.tooltip: Maximum resolution of the downloaded preview texture. The image is displayed smaller with linear filtering.
sspaste.config.client_id.tooltip: Only for existing Imgur applications. New Client-ID registration is currently closed.
sspaste.config.client_id.note: If you already have an Imgur Client-ID, set it here.
sspaste.config.history.link_hover: Open the local upload history page
sspaste.config.history.note: The newest 20 entries are shown. Delete links are secrets; do not share the history files.
sspaste.config.history.gyazo_hover: Open the Gyazo image page (delete from Gyazo)
